standard.summary: 训练结束后自动将 LoRA 权重合并到底模中，导出完整的合并模型而非单独的 LoRA 文件。
standard.effect: merge_export=True 启用合并导出。anima_merge_export 对 Anima 模型有特殊处理。导出的模型是完整的底模 + LoRA 合并结果。
standard.whenToUse: 需要部署独立模型（不依赖推理端支持 LoRA）时。推理端只支持完整模型时。
standard.avoidWhen: 文件会非常大（数 GB 到数十 GB）。失去 LoRA 的灵活性（无法快速切换不同适配器）。

standard_en.summary: Merges the LoRA weights into the base model automatically when training ends, exporting a complete merged model rather than a standalone LoRA file.
standard_en.effect: merge_export=True enables merged export. anima_merge_export handles Anima models specially. The exported model is the complete base plus the merged LoRA.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you need to deploy a standalone model (with no dependency on the inference side supporting LoRA). When the inference side only supports complete models.
standard_en.avoidWhen: The file will be very large (several GB to tens of GB). You lose LoRA's flexibility (no quick switching between adapters).

advanced.principle: 合并公式：W_merged = W_base + scale × (A·B)，其中 A 和 B 是 LoRA 的 down/up 矩阵，scale = alpha/dim。合并后模型推理时不需要额外的 LoRA 加载步骤。anima_merge_export 对 Anima DiT 有特殊处理（可能涉及 Qwen3 LLM adapter 的合并）。prefuse_adapter_path 允许在训练前先将已有 LoRA 合并到底模中。
advanced.intervention: 训练结束后遍历所有 LoRA 权重，计算 delta 并加到底模对应权重上。
advanced.expectedImpact: 导出完整模型。文件增大到完整底模大小。
advanced.tradeoffs: base_weight 和 base_weights_multiplier 支持多 LoRA 加权合并。
advanced.codePath: trainer.py:merge_export → LoRA delta computation → weight addition → full model save

advanced_en.principle: Merge formula: W_merged = W_base + scale × (A·B), where A and B are the LoRA's down/up matrices and scale = alpha/dim. The merged model needs no extra LoRA loading step at inference. anima_merge_export has special handling for Anima DiT (possibly involving Qwen3 LLM adapter merging). prefuse_adapter_path lets an existing LoRA be merged into the base model before training.
advanced_en.intervention: After training, traverses all LoRA weights, computes deltas, and adds them to the base model's corresponding weights.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Exports a full model. File grows to full base-model size.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: base_weight and base_weights_multiplier support weighted multi-LoRA merging.
advanced_en.codePath: trainer.py:merge_export → LoRA delta computation → weight addition → full model save
